summary: Rule 2 of the twelve rules goes neutral in the shipped guidance: in RULE 13 of the managed agent-instructions block, its harness-template mirror and the build-cycle guidance it reads "2. Criteria for what must be proven. A criterion is written for anything the project needs provably tested. Everything else the product needs is the builder's hygiene tests, and a hygiene test is never bound to a criterion.", and names no promise and no buyer. rcf guidance managed/agent-instructions-block, rcf init, rcf doctor --fix, rcf guidance build-cycle and rcf://docs/build-cycle carry it. A project that wants the narrower rule keeps it in its own rules outside the managed markers. No other rule's wording moves; the tool gets no profile or opt-in mechanism; no code enforces rule 2.
approach: guidance/managed/agent-instructions-block.md: rule 2's words under RULE 13, the block keeping its own formatting (bold, line breaks) as the neighbouring rules have it; guidance/build-cycle.md: rule 2's line in its existing one-line form. Then node scripts/gen-managed-artefacts.mjs regenerates guidance/managed/agent-instructions-block.hash and the fragment of guidance/harness-template.md (a BUILD step stated as such; the script is not a declared generator). rcf doctor reports exit 3 on a project's earlier block until rcf doctor --fix, as today; src/setup/managed-block.js, src/cli/doctor.js and src/query/coverage.js are expected to need no change.
deliverables: guidance/managed/agent-instructions-block.md, guidance/harness-template.md and guidance/build-cycle.md: rule 2 states criteria for what must be proven (builder)
guidance/managed/agent-instructions-block.hash and the harness-template fragment regenerated through scripts/gen-managed-artefacts.mjs, a BUILD step, not a declared generator (builder)
AC-20503-4 and AC-20504-4 added to the Code Nodes that implement the criteria they succeed (builder)

The goldens the round moves (the phase-3-6 baseline, queue, bundle and coverage goldens over the dogfood fixture), regenerated through their declared generators at BUILD and again at FINALISE (builder, then the stage-keeper)
The 0.43.0 version, CHANGELOG section and releases feed entry (stage-keeper, at FINALISE)
title: rcf-lite 0.43.0: rule 2 of the twelve rules goes neutral in the managed block, the harness template and the build cycle
